permissions.reason: Save private counter data for this sample plugin
Save sample results into the artifact library
Read previously saved versions of sample results
Show the sample plugin page in the workbench

action.title: Sample health
action.description: Read the sample connector's health without accessing private results.

action.title: Read my sample results
action.description: Read the startup owner's private count and latest personal Artifact.

action.title: Save my sample result
action.description: Publish the next personal Artifact version and update the original private counter.

action.title: Preview a sample result
action.description: Show one saved version of a sample result as readable text; changes nothing.

action.title: Read a sample note
action.description: Read the current text, revision, and links of a sample note.

start.title: New sample note
start.hint: Start a blank note in the sample

action.title: Attach to a sample note
action.description: 把一个对象挂到一条样例笔记上；不复制、不移动原对象，重复挂接不另加一条。

action.title: Read what a thing is attached to
action.description: 读取一个对象此刻挂在哪些样例笔记上；只读。

action.title: Take an attachment off
action.description: 把一个对象从一条样例笔记上取下；原对象不变。

action.title: List sample notes to attach to
action.description: 列出这里可以挂上去的样例笔记，已挂上的在前；只读。

action.title: Make a sample note to attach to
action.description: 新建一条样例笔记并把这个对象挂上去。

action.title: Sample notes: where things stand
action.description: 读取本插件里的工作停在哪里、接着先看哪一项，给外部 Agent 接续会话用；只读，不推断新的状态。

action.title: Read the notes to clear
action.description: Reads the notes a clear would remove, for the person to confirm.

action.title: Clear sample notes
action.description: Removes every sample note and its attachments; the person confirms it in the platform's decision.

action.title: Change a sample setting
action.description: Changes one of the sample's settings.

action.title: Read sample note work-terminal prompt
action.description: Read a sample note's read-only state and instruction for a platform work terminal.

project.schema: CREATE TABLE sample_notes_state (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, notes_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]');
